title: Phantomvista
summary:
Biidaasige Park, a frequent location of late for Daily Photos, isn't the only new recreation space in Toronto's Port Lands. Now a couple of years old, Leslie Lookout Park at the east end of the Shipping Channel is a little more remote, and nearly three quarters of it are a beach, but both of those factors mean that it's a great place for special events, like music and arts festival Phantomfest, as seen here, on the last weekend of August.
